source_scope.source_detail_limit: Only the compensation bill has same-name DDL. Compensation detail and customer-service transfer have no schema. The detailed section additionally defines ods_repay_repay_reason_df, which is absent from the overview and cannot silently replace either missing asset.

verification_policy.specified_definition: A compensation source has same-name DDL plus explicit Case/Decision/Entitlement/Payment/Promotion/AfterSale/Order authority, money/currency rules, identities, security, lifecycle and runtime gate.
verification_policy.verified_definition: Verification requires non-empty production full-denominator reconciliation through exact compensation case, order/item, entitlement type, payment or coupon effect, named funder, currency and independent evidence.

lifecycle_policy_defaults.history_policy: Compensation request, approval decision, entitlement authorization and each execution attempt append; mutable status is only a projection.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.delete_policy: Cancellation or logical deletion retires visibility but never erases approval, coupon grant, payment transfer, ledger, Order/AfterSale linkage or audit history.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.backfill_policy: Resolve tenant, buyer Principal, seller Merchant, Ticket, Order/Item, AfterSale, reason taxonomy version, entitlement type, currency/unit, named funder and exact execution evidence before replay; quarantine ambiguity.

ddl_backed_assets.source_grain: one mutable compensation bill snapshot per source id/bill_no

semantic_rules.grain: one stable compensation case with immutable decisions and one or more typed entitlement/execution facts
semantic_rules.identity: bill, ticket, process, order/sub-order, AfterSale, buyer Principal, seller Merchant, coupon entitlement and payment transfer ids remain distinct qualified identities
semantic_rules.money_or_quantity: order_amount and cash/coin/coupon rules require ISO currency, minor-unit or typed points unit, exact approved amount, named funder and conservation; no cross-unit sum
semantic_rules.history: request/approve/reject/cancel, entitlement authorization, execution attempts and settlement append; is_del/status/pay_status never erase facts
semantic_rules.security: buyer/seller names, remarks, reject reason, payment account and logistics number are restricted/tokenized and excluded from general analytics
semantic_rules.authority: Customer Service owns compensation case/decision; Order and AfterSale own commercial facts; Payment owns cash transfer; Promotion owns coupon; Ledger owns coin; workflow owns approval process

corrections: do not equate compensation with AfterSale or Payment refund
split pay_way 1 coupon, 2 cash and 3 platform coin into typed entitlements with separate execution authorities
quarantine order_amount and coupon_rule amounts until currency, unit, rounding and named funder are proven
replace status/pay_status numeric fields with independently versioned dictionaries
tokenize pay_account, express_no and actor display names
